description: Add a comment to a ticket. Supports @mentions. Open with a sentence or two in plain words saying what happened or what is asked, before any detail. Write #123 only for a ticket number, and p45 for a project.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID, as list_workspaces gives it. Defaults to the one workspace this connection reaches; required when it reaches several.
